items: 【𝟓𝟔 𝐢𝐧 𝟏 𝐆𝐢𝐫𝐥𝐬 𝐌𝐚𝐤𝐞𝐮𝐩 𝐊𝐢𝐭】This set contains a variety of eye-catching makeup sets for your little princess to explore the art of makeup. From shimmering eyeshadows and glossy lip glosses to playful nail polishes, let creativity shine and create a glamorous look.

【𝐅𝐫𝐨𝐳𝐞𝐧 𝐓𝐡𝐞𝐦𝐞 𝐆𝐢𝐫𝐥 𝐓𝐨𝐲𝐬】Every little princess has a pink girly heart, they always dream of fairy tales, and we should protect the child's innocence and princess's dream. The Frozen toys makeup kit uses a unique trapezoidal box and snowflake button design, catering to kids' love of Frozen.

【𝐖𝐚𝐬𝐡𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐞 & 𝐍𝐨𝐧-𝐓𝐨𝐱𝐢𝐜】The play makeup set is made of material that meets US toy safety standards(CPC, CPSIA, ASTM certificates). We promise to be non-toxic, lead, cadmium, phthalates free and skin-friendly. The child can smell the fruity scent when opening it, and it can be easily washed off with soapy water.

【𝐂𝐨𝐦𝐛𝐢𝐧𝐞 𝐄𝐝𝐮𝐜𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐰𝐢𝐭𝐡 𝐄𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐭𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭】We developed the kids makeup set not only to satisfy the girl's pursuit of makeup, but also to make the child's relationship with parents and friends closer, to shape and improve the child's creativity, imagination, aesthetics and hands-on ability, and make them more confident.

【𝐈𝐝𝐞𝐚𝐥 𝐆𝐢𝐟𝐭 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐘𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐏𝐫𝐢𝐧𝐜𝐞𝐬𝐬】The little girls makeup kit can keep kids away from the temptation of electronic devices, encourage kids to play their ideas and make the first try on makeup. It is a surprise gift for 3+ years old girls in Role Play, Birthdays, New Year, Christmas, Halloween, etc.

【𝐒𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐢𝐧𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐌𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐚𝐥𝐬】Made with recycled materials to lower environmental impact, formulated with safer chemicals for user safety and eco-friendliness, and manufactured under ethical standards that prioritize worker well-being, fair treatment, and healthy working conditions. We deliver responsible, eco-conscious quality while supporting social and environmental sustainability."
